operation_timing_rule: integer start_offset_cycles >= 0 and positive duration_cycles contained within the interval; operations sharing a participant or corridor patch cannot overlap
active_volume_rule: sum over intervals of duration_cycles times the physical qubits of every live syndrome-protected patch; all data patches must remain live
failure_rule: sum operation logical_failure_probability as a conservative union bound and require it not to exceed logical_failure_budget

status_rules.complete: distance/patch sizing, live data/factory/buffer patches, connected placement, facing boundaries, nonoverlapping operation windows, distill-buffer-inject-rotation dependencies, term-ordered one-to-one logical-event binding, fixed cycle timing, active volume, and failure allocation are closed; compiled_exact=true; place_route_validated=true; and every evidence status is compiler_export or measured
status_rules.bookkeeping_closed_estimate: all structural and arithmetic checks close, but exact compilation/place-route validation is false or at least one evidence status is derived/assumed
status_rules.unresolved: a required header, patch, layout, connectivity, interval, operation window, dependency, logical-event binding, or failure-budget check is missing or invalid
status_rules.invalid_schema: the contract or ledger identity fields do not match
